Ah, I see it now — the `useSortable` hook from dnd-kit is spreading `attributes` onto the `<section>`, and those attributes include `role="button"` along with `aria-pressed`, `aria-describedby`, and `tabIndex`. That's overriding the section's default role and turning it into a button in the accessibility tree.
